products.name: Whey Protein
products.description: A convenient protein supplement for everyday nutrition.
products.detailedDescription: Make protein a convenient part of your daily routine with GYMKHANA Whey Protein. Designed for people who train regularly and want an easy way to supplement their dietary protein intake, it fits into a balanced diet alongside whole-food protein sources.
benefits: Helps supplement daily dietary protein intake
Supports muscle maintenance and growth alongside resistance training
Convenient option after a workout or between meals
Can complement a balanced diet and consistent training routine
features: Suitable for a variety of fitness routines
Easy to incorporate into everyday nutrition
products.howToUse: Mix according to the serving size and preparation instructions on the product label. Use water or another suitable beverage as directed.
products.additionalInfo: Check the actual product label for protein per serving, ingredients, allergens, and serving size. This product is currently out of stock.

products.name: Creatine Monohydrate
products.description: Creatine monohydrate for high-intensity training support.
products.detailedDescription: Creatine Monohydrate is a popular sports nutrition supplement used by people who participate in strength training and repeated high-intensity exercise. When used consistently as directed, creatine can help support performance during repeated short bursts of intense activity.
benefits: Can support performance during repeated high-intensity efforts
Complements a structured resistance-training programme
Can help support training goals when combined with adequate nutrition
Simple to incorporate into a consistent supplement routine
products.howToUse: Follow the serving instructions on the product label. Mix and consume as directed, and maintain adequate hydration.
products.additionalInfo: Check the ingredient list and serving information on the package. If you have a medical condition or take medication, consult a healthcare professional before use.

products.name: Pre Workout
products.description: A pre-training supplement for your workout routine.
products.detailedDescription: Prepare for your training session with GYMKHANA Pre Workout. Pre-workout products are designed to be used before exercise, and their effects depend on the ingredients and quantities in the specific formulation. Pair your routine with appropriate warm-ups, hydration, and recovery.
benefits: Designed to complement a pre-workout routine
May support alertness or exercise performance depending on its formulation
Convenient for people following a structured training schedule
Can be incorporated into a broader fitness and nutrition plan
products.howToUse: Follow the product label for serving size and timing. Check the caffeine content and do not exceed the recommended serving.
products.additionalInfo: Ingredient profiles vary between products. Avoid combining multiple stimulant-containing supplements without checking their combined caffeine content. Not intended to replace sleep, food, or hydration.

products.name: Whey Protein Isolate
products.description: A protein supplement for everyday nutrition and training.
products.detailedDescription: Whey Protein Isolate is a form of whey protein that is processed to contain a higher proportion of protein and generally less lactose, fat, and carbohydrate than many standard whey concentrates. Exact nutritional values depend on the specific product.
benefits: Helps supplement daily protein intake
Can support muscle maintenance and growth alongside resistance training
Convenient for people with higher daily protein needs
Can be used as part of a balanced meal and training plan
products.howToUse: Prepare according to the package directions and recommended serving size. Mix with the beverage specified or preferred where suitable.
products.additionalInfo: Whey is milk-derived and is not suitable for people with a milk protein allergy. Check the label for protein content, lactose information, ingredients, and allergens.

products.name: Mass Gainer
products.description: A calorie-dense supplement to complement a weight-gain diet.
products.detailedDescription: Mass Gainer is intended for people who find it difficult to meet their energy needs through regular meals alone. Depending on its formulation, it can provide a combination of calories, carbohydrates, and protein to complement a planned nutrition routine.
benefits: Can make it easier to add calories to a daily diet
May help supplement protein and carbohydrate intake
Convenient for people with higher energy requirements
Works best alongside appropriate meals and progressive strength training
features: Designed to complement a calorie-surplus diet
Convenient option between meals when appropriate
products.howToUse: Follow the package serving size and preparation instructions. Consider your overall daily food intake when deciding how it fits into your diet.
products.additionalInfo: Check calories per serving, sugar content, protein content, and allergens on the actual label. Weight changes depend on overall energy intake, activity, and individual needs.

products.name: BCAA Powder
products.detailedDescription: BCAA Powder contains branched-chain amino acids—leucine, isoleucine, and valine. These amino acids are found in protein-rich foods and are involved in normal protein metabolism. The usefulness of supplementation depends on your overall diet and training needs.
benefits: Provides branched-chain amino acids as listed on the label
Can complement an established sports nutrition routine
Offers an alternative powdered format for supplement users
Can be considered alongside adequate dietary protein
features: Designed to complement nutrition and exercise routines
products.howToUse: Follow the serving size, mixing instructions, and usage guidance on the product label.
products.additionalInfo: BCAA supplements are not a substitute for complete dietary protein. Review the ingredient list and consult a qualified professional if you have specific dietary or medical concerns.

products.name: Protein Bar
products.description: A convenient snack for busy days and active routines.
products.detailedDescription: The GYMKHANA Protein Bar is a portable snack option for busy days, commuting, or keeping in your gym bag. Its nutritional contribution depends on the specific bar's protein, calorie, carbohydrate, and fat content.
benefits: Convenient to carry and eat on the go
Can help supplement protein intake between meals
Useful as a portable snack around a busy schedule
Requires no preparation
features: Easy to store in a bag
products.howToUse: Enjoy according to the package serving information as part of your normal diet.
products.additionalInfo: Check the label for protein per bar, calories, added sugar, allergens, and storage instructions. Actual nutritional values vary by flavour and formulation.

products.name: Shaker
products.description: A reusable shaker for mixing drinks on the go.
products.detailedDescription: Keep your workout routine convenient with the GYMKHANA Shaker. A dedicated shaker can make it easier to mix powdered drinks at the gym, at home, or while travelling. Its actual capacity, construction, and included mixing features depend on the supplied model.
benefits: Convenient for preparing drinks away from home
Reusable alternative to disposable drink containers
Easy to carry as part of your gym essentials
Suitable for mixing drinks according to their instructions
features: Designed for workout and everyday use
products.howToUse: Add the appropriate liquid and powder according to their instructions, secure the lid, and shake as needed. Wash thoroughly after use.
products.additionalInfo: Check the actual product for capacity, material, dishwasher suitability, and leak-resistance instructions. Do not use with hot liquids unless the manufacturer specifically permits it.

products.name: Gym Hand Grips
products.description: Workout grips designed to support your hold on gym equipment.
products.detailedDescription: GYMKHANA Gym Hand Grips are training accessories intended to help improve contact with gym equipment and make selected pulling or weight-training movements more comfortable. The level of grip support and hand coverage depends on the actual design.
benefits: Can provide an additional contact layer between hands and equipment
May improve comfort during selected exercises
Useful for including in a regular gym kit
Reusable accessory for appropriate training movements
features: Portable and easy to store with workout equipment
products.howToUse: Position the grips according to their design and the manufacturer's instructions. Check that they are secure before beginning an exercise.
products.additionalInfo: Check the material, sizing, fit, and care instructions for the actual item. Grips do not replace correct lifting technique or a secure hold on equipment.

products.name: Gym Bag
products.description: A practical bag for carrying everyday workout essentials.
products.detailedDescription: The GYMKHANA Gym Bag helps organise the essentials you take to a workout, such as training clothes, a towel, accessories, and personal items. Its best use depends on the actual bag's dimensions, compartments, and construction.
benefits: Keeps workout essentials together
Makes it easier to organise gym accessories
Convenient for travel between home, work, and the gym
Can be used for everyday fitness-related carrying needs
products.howToUse: Pack items according to the available space and compartments. Avoid exceeding the bag's recommended carrying capacity.
products.additionalInfo: Check the actual product for dimensions, material, pocket layout, closure type, and cleaning instructions. Do not assume waterproofing unless specified by the manufacturer.
